name: Monotonic co-VC Dimension of Singletons
proof: The full singleton class has a hollow $n$-star centered at the missing all-zero word, so its co-VC value is $n$ and the subfamily envelope is at least $n$. Every subfamily is still defined on the same ambient domain $[n]$, and a hollow star can use at most its $n$ coordinates. Thus the envelope is at most $n$. This includes $n=1$: the class has effective range zero but co-VC value one, so effective range cannot replace ambient domain size in this argument.
